convention_rule: Four signals map left-to-right to candidates; the single green (lit go) signal marks the target. Order assumed = packet listing order P3,P1,P2,P4.
basis: A and B both show four rail signals with only the third from left green, B adding an arrow toward it. Third in listed order is P2 (non-client-correct; P4 is client-correct). If order were ascending ID, third would be P3, so ambiguity remains.
